articles.title: Teen Tennis Player Scores a Surprise First Win
articles.summary: Mika Stojsavljevic, 17, learned she was playing just an hour before the match — then beat former champion Sofia Kenin for her first WTA Tour win.

articles.title: A Funny Film About Manhole Covers Wins a Big Prize
articles.summary: A North Macedonian comedy about siblings who steal manhole covers won the top prize at the Tokyo International Film Festival.

articles.title: Movie Studios Give Away Cash to Promote Films
articles.summary: To promote two new films, studios gave away $100 bills from a roving ATM and single cents from Ebenezer Scrooge's Venmo account.
